text:
harper: noticed a puzzling pattern post sticky-routing push: reconnect counts in console drop in eu-west but increase in us-east. billing flat.

syl: which panel? `ws.reconnect_summary` or `billing.resume_events`?

harper: `ws.reconnect_summary` live, query: sum(rate(ws.reconnect_summary[5m])) by (region).

jos: probably dedupe key scope changed. We removed region from dedupe hash to keep cardinality low; that can move attribution.

metrics-bot: deploy note: sticky-routing v2 => rl-2026-03-23-21.

product: UX preference: add a console toggle "dedupe scope: regional|global" and keep default regional. Don't flip historical panels.

syl: short-term: mute reconnect surge alert and create temp alert on `billing.resume_events`. I'll open PR.

harper: long-term: reintroduce region into dedupe key but limit sampling window to 10s to bound cardinality.

jos: code sketch: key = f"{region}|{resume_token}|{ts//10}" -> sha1 -> dedupe_id. Emit behind flag `dedupe_region_v2`.

product: also add banner "metrics in flux" during rollout.

syl: owners: syl->alert PR & mute, jos->metric flag & PR, harper->ops playbook, product->console copy. Will monitor dedupe_ratio panel.

harper: thx, I'll keep on-call looped and unmute when stable. :thumbsup:
